bio.text: Nily Rozic has represented the 25th Assembly District in eastern Queens since her election in 2012, when she became the first woman to represent the district.
She chairs the Assembly's Committee on Consumer Affairs and Protection.
Born in Jerusalem and raised in Queens, she was Chief of Staff to Assemblymember Brian Kavanagh before her election and served on Community Board 8.
She graduated from New York University and Syracuse University's Maxwell School and lives in Fresh Meadows.
